description: From J6's report: on a Windows host test_job_sh and one test_pc_deploy test fail because `bash` on PATH is the WSL launcher, not Git Bash. The tests (and any tool that shells out to bash) find Git Bash explicitly or skip with a reason; wsc setup reports which bash it found. Proof: tests green on the PC and on the harness-windows runner.
title: Windows host tests find Git Bash
